scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid active in the MCAD Software
its visible face occupies most of the viewport with its outline visible
the user chooses Zoom Window from the navigation bar Zoom menu
the status area prompts for a zoom window
the user clicks one corner within the visible face
the user clicks an opposite corner within that face
the view zooms into the chosen area
the face extends beyond the viewport
the same part and orientation remain active
the user reopens the Zoom menu
Zoom Window is marked as the selected action
the user chooses Zoom All and then restores Zoom as the selected action
